article.title: 更進新聞：Adobe展示跨鏡頭剪輯原型，兩項影像工具可試
article.summary: Adobe MAX展示10項研發原型，包括跨鏡頭套用場景修改的Scene Sweep。
highlights: Deep Brush和Hands On可在Adobe Labs Playground試用。
Scene Sweep屬研發展示，正式工具的開放安排仍待公布。
article.why: 影像團隊可按已開放的原型安排試驗，並保留跨鏡頭一致性檢查。
article.next_step: 選一段包含不同鏡頭的樣片，記錄場景修改中最耗時的連戲工作。
article.detail: Adobe公布的10項Sneaks聚焦創意工作流程的研發，其中Scene Sweep展示同一場景修改如何延續至其他鏡頭。Adobe另列出Deep Brush和Hands On可在Labs Playground試用。團隊可用這份名單安排短期試驗，並把跨鏡頭修改當作日後評估項目，記錄連戲和審稿要求。
article.title_en: Update: Adobe previews edits across video cuts and offers two image experiments
article.summary_en: Adobe MAX showed 10 R&D prototypes, including Scene Sweep, which carries a scene edit across cuts.
highlights_en: Deep Brush and Hands On can be tried in Adobe Labs Playground.
Scene Sweep is an R&D demonstration, with product availability still to be announced.
article.why_en: Creative teams can plan around experiments they can access and keep continuity checks in their process.
article.next_step_en: Take a short sequence with different shots and note which continuity fixes consume the most time.
article.detail_en: Adobe's 10 Sneaks preview creative R&D. Scene Sweep demonstrates how the same scene edit could carry across shots. Adobe lists Deep Brush and Hands On among the experiments available in Labs Playground. Teams can use the list to plan near-term trials and track continuity and approval needs for future cross-shot editing.
article.followup: 11月12日版報道Creative Agent擴展。本次新增10項研發展示及指定Labs試用名單。
article.followup_en: November 12 covered Creative Agent expansion. This update covers 10 R&D demos and named Labs experiments.
